text:
alex: Kicking off staged rollout for inference-runtime v2.3.1 in the maintenance window (02:00-04:00 UTC). plan = 2% canary -> 10% -> 30% with 15m holds. notifying here for stop/go. release notes: https://internal/release-notes/2.3.1

deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted by CI
Command: `/deploy start --service=inference-runtime --version=v2.3.1 --strategy=staged --steps=2,10,30 --window=02:00-04:00UTC --initiator=@alex`
Status: step 1 (2%) rolling in US/EU/ASIA subsets.

sara-dev: in eu-west-1 I see p95 latency jump ~120ms -> 310ms around 90s after cutover. correlating traces. :mag_right:

leo-sre: alert firing in eu-west: infra_5xx_total rate up, and auth_errors increased slightly. diving into proxy logs.

natalie-sre: quick check — the new batching heuristic changes request bundling; might increase tail latency on cold shards. can we pin region?

ops-jen: we can do a region pin via routing service. command below (ops token required).

```
# pin eu-west to previous version
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing/pin \\
  -d '{"service":"inference-runtime","region":"eu-west-1","version":"v2.3.0"}' \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

alex: proposal: pin eu-west, continue 2% elsewhere, pause next step (10%) until 30m healthcheck. quick vote?

tanya: vote: pin eu-west, continue others at 2%, hold next step. want incident ticket created for KV-cache/batching triage.

sara-dev: vote: pin. I'll attach flamegraphs from the traces once I reproduce in traffic-replay.

leo-sre: vote: pin. also tightening alert thresholds for the next 20m.

op-jen: submitting routing pin now.

deploy-bot: Routing pin submitted by @ops-jen for eu-west-1 -> v2.3.0. status: pending.

deploy-bot: Routing pin executed: eu-west-1 -> v2.3.0. propagation confirmed to edge proxies.

alex: confirmed pin complete. global canary remains at 2% (other regions). pausing 10% step. healthcheck window starts now (+15m).

natalie-sre: FYI I see KV cache miss ratio spike in eu logs prior to latency spike. adding that to the ticket.

sara-dev: reproducing locally with traffic-replay against v2.3.1; initial hypothesis: batching combined with heavier KV traffic is causing lock contention on the cache client. will post logs.

tanya: can we also add a quick smoke of embeddings endpoint during the hold? want to ensure model-serving paths unaffected.

leo-sre: running smoke now. embeddings OK in US, ASIA. will post pass/fail in ~5m.

michael-pm: (popped in) thanks — please update release notes/ops pager if hold extends >20m. customers in EU might see small perturbation, but pin avoids broader impact.

alex: decision recorded: targeted repin for eu-west -> v2.3.0, continue 2% global in other regions, cancel scheduled 10% step until triage complete. contingency: full abort if similar signals appear in US/ASIA. reopen thread with triage outcome. :white_check_mark:
